## Change

Explain the user problem and resulting behavior. Identify affected skills and
any migration or compatibility effect.

## Validation

List actual checks and outcomes. Separate fixture checks from agent evaluations;
state untested behavior and missing runtimes.

- [ ] Metadata, local links, and package boundaries validate.
- [ ] Catalog is current; affected examples/tests are updated.
- [ ] No private data or secrets; attribution and permission boundaries retained.
